mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.topic AS topic, p.content AS content, p.language AS language, p.content_version AS contentVersion, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM community_posts p INNER JOIN members m on p.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.topic AS topic, p.content AS content, p.language AS language, p.content_version AS contentVersion, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM community_posts p INNER JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts ( member_id, topic, content, language, content_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{topic}, #{content}, #{language}, 1, NOW(), NOW() )
